title: Addressing the Author
description: How to write for a reader acting as Author. One rule, moved out of the role's own `voice` field (#1168): a voice points at the role it addresses, so the role names no voice and a second voice for the same reader is added without editing the role.

sources.title: Role `author` — its persona, in the cat-harness role graph

rules.title: Direct and second-person
rules.description: Direct and second-person. Say what to do and what it costs. No preamble, no restating the task back at them.

source.quote: Knows the subject and is mid-edit. Came to change one block, not to learn the system. Has the folio open and the schema only half in mind; will follow a convention if it is stated where they already are, and invent one if it is not.
